restaurants.name: Lestari Indonesisch Restaurant
restaurants.description: Warm, intimate atmosphere right near the Rijnkade with the most incredible traditional Indonesian Rijsttafel for two, homemade sambal, saté, and 20+ flavorful dishes to share.
restaurants.funnyPerk: Sharing a 20-dish Rijsttafel means you don't even have to choose just one meal—we get EVERYTHING.
restaurants.specialDish: Rijsttafel Ibu / Anak, Saté & Udang Goreng
restaurants.dressCode: Gorgeous as always (stretchy waistbands secretly approved)

restaurants.name: Luigi's Imaginary Pasta Shack
restaurants.description: They used to have pasta, until the chef accidentally booked a flight to Bali because he was craving Indonesian food instead.
restaurants.funnyPerk: Wait... why eat plain pasta when we can have a legendary Indonesian Rijsttafel at Lestari?!
restaurants.riggedExcuse: 🚨 Kitchen Alert: Luigi just called—he ran out of spaghetti and told us to go to Lestari Indonesisch Restaurant at 17:45 instead! 🇮🇩✨

restaurants.name: Raw Fish & Regrets Izakaya
restaurants.description: Three microscopic pieces of cucumber roll for €90. Guaranteed to make us stop for snacks on the way home.
restaurants.funnyPerk: Zero chance of beating Lestari's Rijsttafel.
restaurants.riggedExcuse: 🚨 Boyfriend Veto: Friends don't let girlfriends leave dinner hungry! Switching you back to Lestari Indonesisch Restaurant for a royal Rijsttafel feast! 🍛💖

restaurants.name: Le Petit Pretentious Bistro
restaurants.description: A single leaf of kale drizzled with lemon mist served on a skateboard.
restaurants.funnyPerk: Our Democracy™ allows you to vote for anything, as long as the winner is Lestari.
restaurants.riggedExcuse: 🚨 Rigged Election Notice: After a thorough recount of the ballots, Lestari Indonesisch Restaurant won with 100% of the vote! 🗳️🇮🇩
